name: the-flow-ios
description: The iOS shell and home-screen widget for The Flow. Kept out of the server's package.json on purpose — Render should not install a build toolchain it never runs. Capacitor is used once, to generate the project, and then removed: what ships is a plain Xcode project with no CocoaPods and nothing to resolve.

scripts.setup: npm install && npx cap add ios && node scripts/make-native.js && node scripts/add-widget-target.js
